g.text: Which tasks each condition does not solve
For each model, each circle holds the tasks a condition does not solve: tasks only custom code fails (left), tasks both conditions fail (centre) and tasks only Galaxy fails (right);
the tasks on each side are named below it. A condition solves a task when at least 2 of its 3 runs are correct (IWC: ≥ 0.99 output agreement). Circles are not drawn to scale;
tasks solved by both conditions are counted at the top right.
